result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: the third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right side of the screen, preventing users from seeing the complete card information.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated on the right edge of the viewport. Users cannot see the full card content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scrolling carousel has proper padding/margins and that cards are fully visible or can be properly scrolled. Consider adjusting card width or viewport overflow settings to allow complete visibility of all cards in the carousel.
